A note on hygiene: while the source uses an HTTPS tarball from GitHub with a valid checksum, it is version-pinned to a release tag, which is acceptable. There are no SKIP checksums or VCS sources that could introduce unpredictability. All operations during sourcing are declarative and safe.
</details>
